execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."access_tokens" (
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "issued_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "scopes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "session_id" uuid,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "access_token_expiration_after_issue_6afb1a7e" CHECK (expires_at > issued_at),
  CONSTRAINT "access_tokens_scopes_elem_not_null_de6fcc8e" CHECK (array_position("scopes", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."account_recoveries" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason_code" text,
  "request_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "account_recoveries_status_check_3672d297" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'DENIED', 'COMPLETED', 'EXPIRED')),
  CONSTRAINT "account_recovery_expiration_after_creation_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."api_keys" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_used_at" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid,
  "prefix" text NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "scopes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "secret_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "api_key_expiration_after_creation_63443834" CHECK ((expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > created_at)),
  CONSTRAINT "api_key_has_one_owner_3e05d051" CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (organization_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "api_keys_scopes_elem_not_null_de6fcc8e" CHECK (array_position("scopes", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_user_id" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "occurred_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid,
  "resource_id" text,
  "resource_type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."authorization_codes" (
  "code_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "issued_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "nonce" text,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pkce_challenge" text NOT NULL,
  "pkce_challenge_method" text DEFAULT 'S256' NOT NULL,
  "redirect_uri" text NOT NULL,
  "scopes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "session_id" uuid,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "authorization_code_lifetime_and_pkce_34d4868e" CHECK (expires_at > issued_at AND pkce_challenge_method = 'S256' AND (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= issued_at)),
  CONSTRAINT "authorization_codes_scopes_elem_not_null_de6fcc8e" CHECK (array_position("scopes", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."device_authorizations" (
  "approved_at" timestamptz(3),
  "consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_code_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "interval_seconds" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "scopes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_code" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "device_authorization_valid_lifetime_c7226755" CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND interval_seconds > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "device_authorizations_scopes_elem_not_null_de6fcc8e" CHECK (array_position("scopes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "device_authorizations_status_check_2e17e11e" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'DENIED', 'EXPIRED', 'CONSUMED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."devices" (
  "device_key_hash" text,
  "device_type" text,
  "first_seen_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_seen_at" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text,
  "platform" text,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."email_addresses" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_primary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "normalized_email" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "verified_at" timestamptz(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."email_verifications" (
  "consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email_address_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "email_verification_expiration_after_creation_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."external_identities" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_used_at" timestamptz(3),
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "provider_email" text,
  "provider_email_verified" bool,
  "provider_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "external_identities_provider_check_3174518e" CHECK ("provider" IN ('GOOGLE', 'GITHUB', 'APPLE', 'MICROSOFT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."login_attempts" (
  "attempted_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "normalized_email" text,
  "reason_code" text,
  "result" text NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "login_attempts_result_check_17e04d98" CHECK ("result" IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'CHALLENGE', 'BLOCKED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."magic_link_tokens" (
  "consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "normalized_email" text NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "magic_link_expiration_after_creation_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."membership_roles" (
  "assigned_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "assigned_by_id" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "membership_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_allowed_origins" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "origin" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_client_scopes" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "scope_name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_clients" (
  "client_id" text NOT NULL,
  "client_secret_hash" text,
  "client_type" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(3),
  "description" text,
  "grant_types" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid,
  "owner_user_id" uuid,
  "response_types" text[] NOT NULL,
  "token_endpoint_auth_method" text DEFAULT 'NONE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_clients_client_type_check_c951647b" CHECK ("client_type" IN ('WEB', 'SPA_PUBLIC', 'NATIVE', 'DESKTOP', 'CLI', 'SERVICE')),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_clients_grant_types_elem_not_null_c28e7f2a" CHECK (array_position("grant_types", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_clients_response_types_elem_not_null_ef226747" CHECK (array_position("response_types", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_clients_token_endpoint_auth_method_check_54e20f0f" CHECK ("token_endpoint_auth_method" IN ('NONE', 'CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC', 'CLIENT_SECRET_POST', 'PRIVATE_KEY_JWT')),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_confidential_clients_authenticate_627784a4" CHECK ((client_type NOT IN ('WEB', 'SERVICE') OR token_endpoint_auth_method != 'NONE')),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_public_clients_without_secrets_862b8417" CHECK ((client_type NOT IN ('SPA_PUBLIC', 'NATIVE', 'DESKTOP', 'CLI') OR (client_secret_hash IS NULL AND token_endpoint_auth_method = 'NONE'))),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_secret_auth_requires_hash_9e587f70" CHECK ((token_endpoint_auth_method NOT IN ('CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC', 'CLIENT_SECRET_POST') OR client_secret_hash IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_consent_scopes" (
  "consent_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "granted_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "scope_name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_consents" (
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3),
  "granted_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "oauth_consents_status_check_35f03e2c" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'REVOKED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_redirect_uris" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "uri" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_scopes" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_default" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oidc_signing_keys" (
  "activated_at" timestamptz(3),
  "algorithm" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kid" text NOT NULL,
  "private_key_ref" text NOT NULL,
  "public_jwk" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "retired_at" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "oidc_signing_keys_status_check_c585df6e" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'RETIRED', 'REVOKED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization_domains" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "domain" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "verified_at" timestamptz(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization_memberships" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invited_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "joined_at" timestamptz(3),
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'INVITED' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organization_memberships_status_check_b19f1e8b" CHECK ("status" IN ('INVITED', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization_sso_connections" (
  "client_id" text NOT NULL,
  "client_secret_auth_tag" bytea,
  "client_secret_ciphertext" bytea,
  "client_secret_nonce" bytea,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "encrypted_metadata" bytea,
  "encryption_key_ref" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_enabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "issuer_url" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata_auth_tag" bytea,
  "metadata_encryption_key_ref" text,
  "metadata_nonce" bytea,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "protocol" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organization_sso_connections_protocol_check_7f807f88" CHECK ("protocol" IN ('OIDC', 'SAML')),
  CONSTRAINT "sso_metadata_encryption_fields_complete_a6258459" CHECK ((encrypted_metadata IS NULL AND metadata_nonce IS NULL AND metadata_auth_tag IS NULL AND metadata_encryption_key_ref IS NULL) OR (encrypted_metadata IS NOT NULL AND metadata_nonce IS NOT NULL AND metadata_auth_tag IS NOT NULL AND metadata_encryption_key_ref IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "sso_secret_encryption_fields_complete_94e64f24" CHECK ((client_secret_ciphertext IS NULL AND client_secret_nonce IS NULL AND client_secret_auth_tag IS NULL AND encryption_key_ref IS NULL) OR (client_secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND client_secret_nonce IS NOT NULL AND client_secret_auth_tag IS NOT NULL AND encryption_key_ref IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organizations" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organizations_status_check_3a7c0f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."passkey_credentials" (
  "aaguid" text,
  "backed_up" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credential_id" bytea NOT NULL,
  "credential_name" text NOT NULL,
  "device_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_used_at" timestamptz(3),
  "public_key" bytea NOT NULL,
  "signature_counter" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "transports" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "passkey_counter_nonnegative_52a5d894" CHECK (signature_counter >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "passkey_credentials_device_type_check_88a77bfa" CHECK ("device_type" IN ('SINGLE_DEVICE', 'MULTI_DEVICE')),
  CONSTRAINT "passkey_credentials_transports_elem_not_null_59ec2476" CHECK (array_position("transports", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."password_credentials" (
  "changed_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hash_algorithm" text DEFAULT 'argon2id' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "password_hashes_use_argon2id_2204a492" CHECK (hash_algorithm = 'argon2id')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."password_resets" (
  "consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "password_reset_expiration_after_creation_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permissions" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."profiles" (
  "avatar_url" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "locale" text,
  "normalized_username" text,
  "time_zone" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "username" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recovery_codes" (
  "code_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "used_at" timestamptz(3),
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "family_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "issued_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "replacement_of_id" uuid,
  "reuse_detected_at" timestamptz(3),
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "session_id" uuid,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refresh_token_expiration_after_issue_6afb1a7e" CHECK (expires_at > issued_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role_permissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "permission_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_system" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid,
  "role_type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "role_scope_matches_type_0cc457ef" CHECK ((role_type = 'SYSTEM' AND organization_id IS NULL AND is_system = true) OR (role_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL AND is_system = false)),
  CONSTRAINT "roles_role_type_check_c073620d" CHECK ("role_type" IN ('SYSTEM', 'ORGANIZATION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."security_events" (
  "event_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid,
  "occurred_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "session_id" uuid,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "security_events_event_type_check_20f82758" CHECK ("event_type" IN ('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'PASSWORD_RESET', 'PASSKEY_ADDED', 'PASSKEY_REMOVED', 'TOTP_ENABLED', 'TOTP_DISABLED', 'RECOVERY_CODE_USED', 'OAUTH_AUTHORIZED', 'OAUTH_REVOKED', 'SESSION_CREATED', 'SESSION_REVOKED', 'API_KEY_CREATED', 'API_KEY_REVOKED', 'ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_STARTED', 'ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."security_notifications" (
  "body" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "read_at" timestamptz(3),
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "security_notifications_type_check_84a4d919" CHECK ("type" IN ('NEW_LOGIN', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'PASSWORD_RESET', 'PASSKEY_ADDED', 'PASSKEY_REMOVED', 'TOTP_CHANGED', 'SESSION_REVOKED', 'OAUTH_ACCESS_GRANTED', 'OAUTH_ACCESS_REVOKED', 'API_KEY_CHANGED', 'ACCOUNT_RECOVERY', 'SECURITY_ALERT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_id" uuid,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "last_seen_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "oauth_client_id" uuid,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "session_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "session_expiration_after_creation_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "enabled_at" timestamptz(3),
  "encryption_algorithm" text DEFAULT 'AES-256-GCM' NOT NULL,
  "encryption_key_ref" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_enabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "secret_auth_tag" bytea NOT NULL,
  "secret_ciphertext" bytea NOT NULL,
  "secret_nonce" bytea NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "totp_enabled_state_matches_timestamp_1c0adfb5" CHECK (is_enabled = (enabled_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "totp_secret_is_encrypted_dede529d" CHECK (octet_length(secret_ciphertext) > 0 AND octet_length(secret_nonce) > 0 AND octet_length(secret_auth_tag) > 0)
)

  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_matches_deleted_at_0d235242" CHECK ((status = 'DELETED') = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_3a7c0f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhook_deliveries" (
  "attempt_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "next_attempt_at" timestamptz(3),
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
